biography:
I have over 16 years of experience within the Data Centre Sector and during this time I have advised a wide range of multi national corporate organisations in what is a complicated and challenging area of technical real estate. Although I also have a background of Landlord representation within the Data Centre sector, my focus area has been Occupier representation and key to this is providing colocation strategy and advisory across the global markets. I have now taken this skill set one step further and in my current role I offer technical real estate solutions on behalf of Ark Data Centres.

I also share a background in core Real Estate and in particular Industrial and Office Representation and Transaction Management within the Global Corporate Solutions sector which has further bolstered my firm grasp of understanding large business needs in multi sector real estate.  
My experiences in dealing with international Data Centre and Business Continuity Space, clients’ requirements hold me in a unique position of being currently one of the very few in the global market who are able to provide corporations and businesses with a technical delivery focus, with experienced expert technical advice.

To date I have personally led and been involved with over 250 Data Centre transactions, made up of acquisitions, expansions and renewals. This has incorporated advising over 30 clients in 56 countries in 100+ data centre markets around the world. I have so far advised on 150 MW+ of colocation space, acquired 200MW+ of powered land and disposed of 25MW of technical space.
